verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents an official MCP server (docs.semgrep.dev/mcp), which is the standard mechanism for wiring a scanner into an AI coding agent so it can invoke scans on AI-generated code before it lands, and Semgrep also supports pre-commit hooks and CI gating that fit the broader workflow. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP server's exact tool surface/behavior, hands-on or independent verification that agents actually use it pre-merge, and community reports confirming real-world adoption of this specific integration.
